R6C-bear-drive-0002.name: By Deena Creek
R6C-bear-drive-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6C-bear-drive-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Deena West Main (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2008 (18 years old), 90 m S: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
S facing slope, 12 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Deena Creek 80 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

seasonRows.notes: MU 6-12 is not listed in the Region 6 black bear rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 21 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.11679, -132.18603, pull off on Deena West Main (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 50 m S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, season: VERIFY. Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-12, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.

R6C-grouse-drive-0002.name: By Deena Creek
R6C-grouse-drive-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R6C-grouse-drive-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Deena West Main (paved road)

evidence.t: Road: Deena West Main, 4.9 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
13 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Private land 200 m N: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 16 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.14068, -132.1454, pull off on Deena West Main (paved road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Deena West Main stretch, 4.9 km one way. About 98 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-12, Region 6. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 51, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
